name: Divine Justification (Combat)
body:
Your faith grants healing to your allies and harms your enemies.

Prerequisite(s): Power Attack, Selective Channel, Channel Energy Class Feature

Benefit: If you use Power Attack, and Selective Channel, during the same round you heal allies and harm enemies at the same time.

Special: Healing is equal to the damage before the Will saving throw is made to determine if the damage is halved.

Normal: When Channeling Energy you must choose to heal or harm.
